DOP: coḷa, cola m.n. [ cf S. cola; BHS coḍa]; cloth; a piece of cloth; a garment ; Abh 290 (dussaṃ ~o ca sāṭako); Vin II 150, 29 (addasāsuṃ kho bhikkhū samajjaṭṭhāne bahuṃ uṇṇaṃ pi ~aṃ pi vākaṃ pi tiṇaṃ pi paṇṇaṃ pi chaḍḍitāni, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be colakaṃ); S I 34, 17* (dalidde jāyare kule ~aṃ piṇḍo ratī khiḍḍā yattha kicchena labbhati); Th 170 (sabbe ~ā samucchinnā natthi dāni punabbhavo; cf Th-a II 46, 5 foll. : sabbe ~ā samucchinnā ti corā viya kusalabhaṇḍacchedanato, sādhūhi alātabbato asaṅgahetabbato saṅkārakūṭādīsu chaḍḍitapilotikakhaṇḍaṃ viya issarajanena ariyajanena jigucchitabbatāya ~ā viyā ti vā ~ā ti laddhanāmā kilesā samucchinnā; see K.R. Norman, 2007a, p. 178 ); Thī 1 (sukhaṃ supāhi therike katvā ~ena pārutā); Ja VI 297, 15* (~aṃ ca nesaṃ piṇḍaṃ ca āsīnānaṃ va dāpaye); Sp 646, 16 (mahante ~e); 1293, 15 (coḷapaṭṭādīsu coḷakāsāvaṃ ~an ti veditabbaṃ); Sadd 353, 6* (paṭo ~o sāṭako ca vāso vasanam aṃsukaṃ …); — ifc see nahāna-, vaṇacchādana-, saṅkāra-; — °- paṭṭa , m. , a strip of cloth ; Vin II 266, 12 (bhikkhuniyo … ~ena phāsuke namenti colaveṇiyā … colavaṭṭiyā …); Mil 74, 2 (so vaṇo … sukhumena ca ~ena paliveṭhīyatī ti); — °- bhisi , f. , a cushion stuffed with cloth ; Vin II 150, 31 (anujānāmi bhikkhave pañca bhisiyo uṇṇabhisiṃ ~iṃ vākabhisiṃ tiṇabhisiṃ paṇṇabhisin ti); — °- vaṭṭi , f. , a roll of cloth ; Vin II 266, 12 ; — °- veṇi , f. , a twist or plait of cloth ; Vin II 266, 12 ; — acoḷa , mfn. , without clothes ; Spk I 82, 26 (yasmā surūpo pi duccoḷo vā ~o vā virūpo hoti); — duccola , duccoḷa , mfn. , wearing poor clothes; wearing a robe made from poor cloth ; Vin I 109, 25 (tāni cīvarāni nassanti pi ḍayhanti pi undurehi pi khajjanti, bhikkhū ~ā honti lūkhacīvarā ti); IV 245, 20 (bhikkhuniyo … ~ā lūkhacīvarā; Sp 916, 21 : ~ā ti virūpa-coḷā jiṇṇacoḷā ti attho); Spk I 82, 26 ; — niccola , niccoḷa , mfn. , without clothes ; Pv-a 43, 13 (ahaṃ sāmi ~ā ativiya jighacchāpipāsābhibhūtā vicarāmi, dehi me vatthaṃ annapānaṃ cā ti); Nidd-a I 430, 3 (acelako ti ~o naggo); — see also dhuvacolā ( sv dhuva ).
